sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Norfolk Southern Railway seeks to overturn a lower court ruling. The lower court applied a standard requiring a direct causal link. The railroad argues this standard is incorrect under federal law.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines how courts calculate worker negligence in injury claims. It determines the financial liability of railroads for workplace accidents. It shapes the legal standard for proving causation in federal employment law.
